function.name: parse_resume
function.description: Parses a resume and returns structured candidate information and ranks the resume.

name.description: Candidate's full name. Truncate to 120 characters.

skills.description: List of technical skills and tools mentioned in the resume separated by comma. Truncate to 120 characters.

projects.description: List of relevant projects names mentioned in the resume separated by comma. Truncate to 120 characters

education.description: Degrees or academic qualifications mentioned in the resume separated by comma. Truncate to 120 characters.

rank.description: Give a rank in the scale of 1-10 about this resume.

remarks.description: Remarks in 120 characters about this resume and reason for the awareded rank.
